projection.method: the L512 H96 cells measure 1258 CPU s each; the completed protocol-A campaign gives the measured per-horizon ratios under the SAME early stopping (patience 3), which dominate cost far more than the horizon length does
projection.verdict: the ten remaining cells and their verification fit inside the declared 24000 s allocation with roughly 45 percent headroom
caveats: cost is driven by how many epochs early stopping actually runs, not by the horizon: protocol A's h336 and h720 cells were CHEAPER than its h96 cells
the protocol-A ratios come from cells trained on more than one host, so they are an anchor for the shape of the cost, not a per-host prediction
protocol B carries four patches per channel against three and 1284 tokens against 963, which the L512 H96 measurement already includes
